plans.idea: Brand-first left-to-right read: Solstice logo opens the strip at left, a wide central text block carries the headline with the subline beneath it, and the bottle closes on the right exactly as in the original.
Product-first: the orange bottle anchors the left edge as the eye-catcher, the headline and subline read next in a wide block, and the logo signs off at the right end like a brand stamp.

Message-first like the original's left column: a left-aligned headline-over-subline block takes the first two-thirds, and the logo and bottle are grouped together as one brand/product cluster at the right.
